newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli bank to compensate provident fund holders.
newsitem.headline: Israeli bank to compensate provident fund holders.

text.p: Bank Hapoalim said on Sunday that it would compensate provident fund holders by approximately 12 million shekels for losses caused them by Ilan Tsabari, a former fund manager.

Hapoalim said the amount was determined by an outside accounting firm, which had investigated the extent of the damage caused by Tsubari's alleged manipulation of share prices before he was arrested in April 1994.

Tsubari is facing trial, and Hapoalim said its decision to pay compensation had no connection with its outcome. It said the 12 million shekels would be transferred to its provident funds by the end of December.
